a2a_outbound_continuation_owner.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX a2a_outbound_continuation_owner ON a2a_outbound_dispatches (sender_id, sender_tenant, parent_dispatch_id) WHERE parent_dispatch_id IS NOT NULL AND state != 'not-sent'

a2a_outbound_remote_task_owner.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX a2a_outbound_remote_task_owner ON a2a_outbound_dispatches (sender_id, sender_tenant, recipient_id, tenant, remote_task_id) WHERE remote_task_id IS NOT NULL AND parent_dispatch_id IS NULL

a2a_outbound_sender_created.sql: CREATE INDEX a2a_outbound_sender_created ON a2a_outbound_dispatches (sender_id, sender_tenant, created_at DESC, dispatch_id DESC)

a2a_task_changes_forwarded.sql: CREATE INDEX a2a_task_changes_forwarded ON a2a_task_changes (recipient_id, tenant, forwarded_event_id) WHERE forwarded_event_id IS NOT NULL

a2a_task_changes_pending.sql: CREATE INDEX a2a_task_changes_pending ON a2a_task_changes (recipient_id, tenant, sequence) WHERE forwarded_event_id IS NULL

a2a_task_changes_task.sql: CREATE INDEX a2a_task_changes_task ON a2a_task_changes (recipient_id, tenant, task_id, sequence)

idx_a2a_wake_obligations_live.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_a2a_wake_obligations_live ON a2a_wake_obligations (agent_id, consumer_id, live_delivery_id) WHERE live_delivery_id IS NOT NULL

idx_a2a_wake_obligations_state.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_a2a_wake_obligations_state ON a2a_wake_obligations (agent_id, consumer_id, state)

idx_obs_agent_type.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_obs_agent_type ON a2a_observability(agent_name, event_type)

idx_tool_dispatches_agent_ts.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_tool_dispatches_agent_ts ON a2a_tool_dispatches(agent_did, ts)

idx_tool_dispatches_agent_turn.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_tool_dispatches_agent_turn ON a2a_tool_dispatches(agent_did, turn_id, id)

idx_tool_dispatches_dispatch.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_tool_dispatches_dispatch ON a2a_tool_dispatches(agent_did, dispatch_id)

idx_tool_dispatches_parent.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_tool_dispatches_parent ON a2a_tool_dispatches(agent_did, parent_dispatch_id)

idx_tool_dispatches_status.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_tool_dispatches_status ON a2a_tool_dispatches(agent_did, result_status)

a2a_contexts.sql: CREATE TABLE a2a_contexts ( context_id TEXT NOT NULL, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, recipient_agent_id TEXT NOT NULL, creator_agent_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')), PRIMARY KEY (recipient_agent_id, tenant, context_id) )

a2a_llm_calls.sql: CREATE TABLE a2a_llm_calls ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, timestamp TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')), agent_did TEXT, session_id TEXT, companion_id TEXT, user_id TEXT, provider TEXT NOT NULL, model TEXT NOT NULL, system_prompt_preview TEXT, user_prompt_preview TEXT, response_preview TEXT, input_tokens INTEGER, output_tokens INTEGER, duration_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, success INTEGER DEFAULT 1, error_message TEXT, tool_calls TEXT, metadata TEXT DEFAULT '{}' )

a2a_native_question_wakes.sql: CREATE TABLE a2a_native_question_wakes ( sender_id TEXT NOT NULL, sender_tenant TEXT NOT NULL, question_id TEXT NOT NULL, wave TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (wave IN ('answer','deadline','late-answer')), event_id TEXT NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, claim_token TEXT, lease_until TEXT, handed_off_at TEXT, delivery_failed_at TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (sender_id, sender_tenant, question_id, wave), UNIQUE (sender_id, sender_tenant, event_id) )

a2a_native_questions.sql: CREATE TABLE a2a_native_questions ( sender_id TEXT NOT NULL, sender_tenant TEXT NOT NULL, question_id TEXT NOT NULL, dispatch_id TEXT NOT NULL, recipient_id TEXT NOT NULL, recipient_tenant TEXT NOT NULL, original_question TEXT NOT NULL, request_json TEXT NOT NULL, origin_turn_id TEXT NOT NULL, origin_session_id TEXT NOT NULL, causation_json TEXT NOT NULL, deadline TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('WAITING', 'RESOLVED', 'EXPIRED')), receiver_settled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (receiver_settled IN (0,1)), response_json TEXT, response_digest TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (sender_id, sender_tenant, question_id), UNIQUE (sender_id, sender_tenant, dispatch_id) )

a2a_native_store_schema.sql: CREATE TABLE a2a_native_store_schema ( component TEXT PRIMARY KEY, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision > 0) )

a2a_observability.sql: CREATE TABLE a2a_observability ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, timestamp TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')), agent_name TEXT NOT NULL, session_id TEXT, event_type TEXT NOT NULL, tool_name TEXT, duration_ms INTEGER, success INTEGER DEFAULT 1, error_message TEXT, metadata TEXT DEFAULT '{}' )

a2a_outbound_dispatches.sql: CREATE TABLE a2a_outbound_dispatches ( dispatch_id TEXT NOT NULL, sender_id TEXT NOT NULL, sender_tenant TEXT NOT NULL, recipient_id TEXT NOT NULL, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, signing_did TEXT NOT NULL, interface_url TEXT NOT NULL, protocol_binding TEXT NOT NULL, message_id TEXT NOT NULL, requested_context_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_digest TEXT NOT NULL, message_digest TEXT NOT NULL, dispatch_tool TEXT NOT NULL, verb TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('reserved', 'submitting', 'unknown', 'not-sent', 'acknowledged', 'complete')), revision BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (revision >= 0), remote_task_id TEXT, remote_context_id TEXT, remote_task_state TEXT, response_digest TEXT, response_kind TEXT, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, operation_id TEXT NOT NULL, cancel_operation_id TEXT, cancel_request_digest TEXT, cancel_state TEXT CHECK (cancel_state IN ('reserved', 'submitting', 'unknown', 'not-sent', 'acknowledged', 'complete')), root_dispatch_id TEXT NOT NULL, parent_dispatch_id TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (sender_id, sender_tenant, dispatch_id), UNIQUE (sender_id, sender_tenant, message_id), FOREIGN KEY (sender_id, sender_tenant, root_dispatch_id) REFERENCES a2a_outbound_dispatches (sender_id, sender_tenant, dispatch_id), FOREIGN KEY (sender_id, sender_tenant, parent_dispatch_id) REFERENCES a2a_outbound_dispatches (sender_id, sender_tenant, dispatch_id) )

a2a_protocol_schema.sql: CREATE TABLE a2a_protocol_schema ( singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision = 1) )

a2a_sessions.sql: CREATE TABLE a2a_sessions ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, agent_name TEXT NOT NULL, user_id TEXT, state TEXT DEFAULT '{}', events TEXT DEFAULT '[]', metadata TEXT DEFAULT '{}', created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')), updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')) )

a2a_task_changes.sql: CREATE TABLE a2a_task_changes ( sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, recipient_id TEXT NOT NULL, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES a2a_tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, forwarded_event_id TEXT )

a2a_task_inputs.sql: CREATE TABLE a2a_task_inputs ( task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES a2a_tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, input_revision BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (input_revision >= 0), message_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_json TEXT NOT NULL, request_digest TEXT NOT NULL, wire_request_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(wire_request_digest) = 64), PRIMARY KEY (task_id, input_revision), UNIQUE (task_id, message_id) )

a2a_tasks.sql: CREATE TABLE a2a_tasks ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT, user_id TEXT, task_type TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT DEFAULT 'submitted', message TEXT, artifacts TEXT DEFAULT '[]', history TEXT DEFAULT '[]', metadata TEXT DEFAULT '{}', created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')), updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')), creator_agent_id TEXT, recipient_agent_id TEXT, canceled_by TEXT, cancel_reason TEXT, cancel_previous_status TEXT, cancel_operation_id TEXT, terminal_operation_id TEXT, lifecycle_revision BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, lifecycle_updated_at TEXT, status_timestamp_seconds BIGINT, status_timestamp_nanos INTEGER, tenant TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', cognition_wake_eligible INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (cognition_wake_eligible IN (0,1)), input_revision BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (input_revision >= 0), input_wake_eligible INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (input_wake_eligible IN (0,1)) )

a2a_tool_dispatches.sql: CREATE TABLE a2a_tool_dispatches ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, agent_did TEXT NOT NULL, session_id TEXT, turn_id TEXT NOT NULL, ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')), tool_name TEXT NOT NULL, adapter TEXT NOT NULL, args_redacted TEXT NOT NULL, result_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( result_status IN ('success', 'error', 'empty', 'policy_denied', 'timeout') ), error_class TEXT, error_message TEXT, latency_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, result_size_bytes INTEGER, dispatch_id TEXT, parent_dispatch_id TEXT )

a2a_wake_obligations.sql: CREATE TABLE a2a_wake_obligations ( agent_id TEXT NOT NULL, consumer_id TEXT NOT NULL, task_id TEXT NOT NULL, input_revision BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (input_revision >= 0), generation BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (generation >= 1), state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('owed', 'bound', 'ran', 'conflict', 'ended', 'released')), live_delivery_id TEXT, updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')), PRIMARY KEY (agent_id, consumer_id, task_id, input_revision), CHECK (state <> 'bound' OR live_delivery_id IS NOT NULL), CHECK (state NOT IN ('owed', 'conflict') OR live_delivery_id IS NULL) )

a2a_tasks_authority_insert_v5.sql: CREATE TRIGGER a2a_tasks_authority_insert_v5 BEFORE INSERT ON a2a_tasks FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.creator_agent_id IS NULL OR NEW.recipient_agent_id IS NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A2A task requires durable authority'); END

a2a_tasks_live_authority_update_v5.sql: CREATE TRIGGER a2a_tasks_live_authority_update_v5 BEFORE UPDATE ON a2a_tasks FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.status IN ('submitted', 'working', 'input-required', 'auth-required') AND (NEW.creator_agent_id IS NULL OR NEW.recipient_agent_id IS NULL) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'live A2A task requires durable authority'); END

a2a_tasks_terminal_replace_v5.sql: CREATE TRIGGER a2a_tasks_terminal_replace_v5 BEFORE INSERT ON a2a_tasks FOR EACH ROW WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM a2a_tasks WHERE id = NEW.id AND status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'canceled', 'rejected') ) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(IGNORE); END

a2a_tasks_terminal_update_v5.sql: CREATE TRIGGER a2a_tasks_terminal_update_v5 BEFORE UPDATE ON a2a_tasks FOR EACH ROW WHEN OLD.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'canceled', 'rejected') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'terminal A2A task cannot be replaced'); END

idx_feedback_agent.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_feedback_agent ON a2a_feedback(agent_name, status)

idx_feedback_status.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_feedback_status ON a2a_feedback(status, severity)

a2a_feedback.sql: CREATE TABLE a2a_feedback ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, agent_name TEXT NOT NULL, session_id TEXT, source TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL, severity TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT DEFAULT 'open', title TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL, context TEXT DEFAULT '{}', resolution TEXT, created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')), updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')), resolved_at TEXT, metadata TEXT DEFAULT '{}' )

a2a_memory.sql: CREATE TABLE a2a_memory ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT, content TEXT, tags TEXT DEFAULT '[]', metadata TEXT DEFAULT '{}', created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')) )

a2a_memory_fts.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE a2a_memory_fts USING fts5( content, content='a2a_memory', content_rowid='rowid' )

a2a_memory_ad.sql: CREATE TRIGGER a2a_memory_ad AFTER DELETE ON a2a_memory BEGIN INSERT INTO a2a_memory_fts(a2a_memory_fts, rowid, content) VALUES('delete', old.rowid, old.content); END

a2a_memory_ai.sql: CREATE TRIGGER a2a_memory_ai AFTER INSERT ON a2a_memory BEGIN INSERT INTO a2a_memory_fts(rowid, content) VALUES (new.rowid, new.content); END

a2a_memory_au.sql: CREATE TRIGGER a2a_memory_au AFTER UPDATE ON a2a_memory BEGIN INSERT INTO a2a_memory_fts(a2a_memory_fts, rowid, content) VALUES('delete', old.rowid, old.content); INSERT INTO a2a_memory_fts(rowid, content) VALUES (new.rowid, new.content); END

a2a_push_active_tasks.sql: CREATE INDEX a2a_push_active_tasks ON a2a_push_configs (recipient_id, tenant, task_id) WHERE state = 'active'

a2a_push_current_config.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX a2a_push_current_config ON a2a_push_configs (recipient_id, tenant, task_id, config_id) WHERE state = 'active'

a2a_push_live_attempts.sql: CREATE INDEX a2a_push_live_attempts ON a2a_push_delivery_attempts (recipient_id, tenant, task_id, config_id, generation, retired)

a2a_push_retiring_configs.sql: CREATE INDEX a2a_push_retiring_configs ON a2a_push_configs (recipient_id, tenant, task_id, config_id, generation) WHERE state = 'deleting'

a2a_push_unretired_processes.sql: CREATE INDEX a2a_push_unretired_processes ON a2a_push_delivery_attempts (recipient_id, tenant, attempt_id) WHERE retired = 0

a2a_push_configs.sql: CREATE TABLE a2a_push_configs ( recipient_id TEXT NOT NULL, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, creator_id TEXT NOT NULL, task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES a2a_tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, config_id TEXT NOT NULL, generation TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('active', 'deleting', 'deleted')), ciphertext TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (recipient_id, tenant, task_id, config_id, generation), CHECK ((state = 'deleted') = (ciphertext IS NULL)) )

a2a_push_delivery_attempts.sql: CREATE TABLE a2a_push_delivery_attempts ( recipient_id TEXT NOT NULL, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, task_id TEXT NOT NULL, config_id TEXT NOT NULL, creator_id TEXT NOT NULL, generation TEXT NOT NULL, attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, executor_id TEXT NOT NULL, owner_identity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(owner_identity) > 0), retired INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (retired IN (0, 1)), FOREIGN KEY (recipient_id, tenant, task_id, config_id, generation) REFERENCES a2a_push_configs(recipient_id, tenant, task_id, config_id, generation) )

a2a_push_subscriptions.sql: CREATE TABLE a2a_push_subscriptions ( recipient_id TEXT NOT NULL, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, task_id TEXT NOT NULL, config_id TEXT NOT NULL, generation TEXT NOT NULL, creator_id TEXT NOT NULL, agent_id TEXT NOT NULL, consumer_id TEXT NOT NULL, after_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (after_sequence >= 0), PRIMARY KEY (recipient_id, tenant, task_id, config_id, generation), UNIQUE (agent_id, consumer_id), FOREIGN KEY (agent_id, consumer_id) REFERENCES durable_signal_consumers (agent_id, consumer_id), FOREIGN KEY (recipient_id, tenant, task_id, config_id, generation) REFERENCES a2a_push_configs (recipient_id, tenant, task_id, config_id, generation) ON DELETE CASCADE )

a2a_push_task_cleanup_v1.sql: CREATE TRIGGER a2a_push_task_cleanup_v1 BEFORE DELETE ON a2a_tasks WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM a2a_push_configs WHERE task_id = OLD.id AND state != 'deleted') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'task has an active push configuration'); END

a2a_task_changes_insert_v2.sql: CREATE TRIGGER a2a_task_changes_insert_v2 AFTER INSERT ON a2a_tasks WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM a2a_push_configs cfg JOIN a2a_push_subscriptions sub ON sub.recipient_id = cfg.recipient_id AND sub.tenant = cfg.tenant AND sub.task_id = cfg.task_id AND sub.config_id = cfg.config_id AND sub.generation = cfg.generation JOIN durable_signal_consumers consumer ON consumer.agent_id = sub.agent_id AND consumer.consumer_id = sub.consumer_id WHERE cfg.recipient_id = NEW.recipient_agent_id AND cfg.tenant = NEW.tenant AND cfg.task_id = NEW.id AND cfg.state = 'active' AND consumer.active = TRUE ) BEGIN INSERT INTO a2a_task_changes (recipient_id, tenant, task_id) VALUES (NEW.recipient_agent_id, NEW.tenant, NEW.id); END

a2a_task_changes_update_v2.sql: CREATE TRIGGER a2a_task_changes_update_v2 AFTER UPDATE ON a2a_tasks WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM a2a_push_configs cfg JOIN a2a_push_subscriptions sub ON sub.recipient_id = cfg.recipient_id AND sub.tenant = cfg.tenant AND sub.task_id = cfg.task_id AND sub.config_id = cfg.config_id AND sub.generation = cfg.generation JOIN durable_signal_consumers consumer ON consumer.agent_id = sub.agent_id AND consumer.consumer_id = sub.consumer_id WHERE cfg.recipient_id = NEW.recipient_agent_id AND cfg.tenant = NEW.tenant AND cfg.task_id = NEW.id AND cfg.state = 'active' AND consumer.active = TRUE ) BEGIN INSERT INTO a2a_task_changes (recipient_id, tenant, task_id) VALUES (NEW.recipient_agent_id, NEW.tenant, NEW.id); END
